data.text:
Some updates from our little town here in the Pampanga Philippines, experienced severe flooding, not because of a typhoon, but due to the destruction of several fishponds. Thankfully, it only caused heavy floods and a lot of mess from fallen trees and scattered debris in our surroundings.

M family and I are safe and slowly getting back to normal life. Now we go back to grinding our way out of hardship, because really, there’s nothing else we can do but keep going.

Back to grinding our way out of the rat race, trade, gaming, and the @PulseInfra's campaign. @boostdotgg.
